description:
Track time against threads, billable and not; entries live one file per thread under the vault's hours directory.

Subcommands:
  log THREAD DESCRIPTION... [-m MINUTES] [-r RATE] [-c CURRENCY] [-d YYYY-MM-DD] [-t HH:MM] — append an entry (INTERACTIVE if THREAD is omitted)
  list [THREAD] [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--until YYYY-MM-DD] [--json] — list entries
  report [--thread THREAD] [--since YYYY-MM-DD] [--until YYYY-MM-DD] [--json] — totals by thread and currency, unbilled time totalled separately
  show ID [--json] — show one entry
  edit ID [--description TEXT] [-m MINUTES] [-r RATE] [-c CURRENCY] [-d YYYY-MM-DD] [-t HH:MM] — change one field of an entry
  rm ID [-y] — delete an entry (DESTRUCTIVE)

Flags:
  log: -m duration in minutes, default 60; -r hourly rate, 0 means unbillable; -c ISO currency code, defaults to the thread's, and without either the entry is recorded as unbilled; -d date, default today; -t time, default now; --all only affects the interactive thread picker.
  edit: --description new description; -m, -r, -c, -d, -t as for log.
  rm: -y skips confirmation.

Examples:
  ["log", "Projects/SGB", "DORA metric validation", "-m", "180"]
  ["log", "Topics/Fitness", "5k run", "-m", "30", "-r", "0"]
  ["list", "Projects/SGB", "--since", "2026-05-01", "--json"]
  ["report", "--since", "2026-05-01", "--until", "2026-05-31", "--json"]

Notes:
  Never call `log` without a THREAD positional and never with --all: that path opens an interactive picker on stdin. Always pass the thread and description on the argv.
  THREAD is a thread name, 'Kind/Name', or wikilink and must resolve to an existing thread file.
  DESCRIPTION is variadic; each word may be a separate argv element, but pass it as one element. It is an invoice line item and is not indexed by `search` — put narrative in a log line via `buffer add-text`, not here.
  ID is the 8-hex entry id; hours and payments ids share one namespace.
